name: Release Relay
run-name: "${{ (github.event_name == 'schedule' || inputs.mode == 'archive') && 'Release Relay nightly archive' || format('Release Relay {0} ({1})', inputs.request_id, inputs.mode) }}"

on:
  # Nightly archive. Cron is UTC: 0 8 * * * is 2:00 AM Central in winter (CST), 3:00 AM in summer (CDT); change the
  # hour to your quiet time. GitHub may start it a few minutes late.
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 8 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      request_id:
        description: Salesforce release number (blank for archive)
        required: false
        type: string
      mode:
        description: org, branch, promote, hub, resolve, check, merge, sync, rollback, or archive (the nightly archive, by hand)
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [org, branch, promote, hub, resolve, check, merge, sync, rollback, archive]
      environment:
        description: GitHub environment of the source org (sync = the hub's production org)
        required: false
        type: string
      target_environment:
        description: GitHub environment of the target org (blank = Git only, no validate or deploy)
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      branch:
        description: Source branch (sync = the hub's production branch)
        required: false
        type: string
      target:
        description: Target branch (sync = the back-promote org's branch)
        required: false
        type: string
      title:
        description: Pull request title
        required: false
        type: string
      components:
        description: Type:Name list to retrieve, comma separated (promote = the releases' merge commits)
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      deletions:
        description: Type:Name list to delete, comma separated
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      options:
        description: 'JSON options from Salesforce, for example {"scan":"off","notify":"dev"}'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: '{}'

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

# One run at a time per release branch; back promotes, one at a time per back-promote branch; rollbacks, one at
# a time per org; the nightly archive, one at a time.
concurrency:
  group: release-relay-${{ github.event_name == 'schedule' && 'archive' || (inputs.mode == 'rollback' && format('rollback-{0}', inputs.target_environment) || (inputs.mode == 'sync' && inputs.target || inputs.branch)) }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  RELAY_PROVIDER: github
  REQUEST_ID: ${{ inputs.request_id }}
  MODE: ${{ inputs.mode }}
  ENVIRONMENT: ${{ inputs.environment }}
  TARGET_ENVIRONMENT: ${{ inputs.target_environment }}
  BRANCH: ${{ inputs.branch }}
  TARGET: ${{ inputs.target }}
  TITLE: ${{ inputs.title }}

jobs:
  raise:
    if: ${{ inputs.mode == 'org' || inputs.mode == 'branch' || inputs.mode == 'promote' || inputs.mode == 'hub' || inputs.mode == 'resolve' }}

    environment: ${{ inputs.environment }}
    timeout-minutes: 30

      - name: Create GitHub App token
        id: app
        if: ${{ vars.RELAY_APP_ID != '' }}
        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@v1
        with:
          app-id: ${{ vars.RELAY_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELAY_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          token: ${{ steps.app.outputs.token || github.token }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

# One run at a time per release branch; back promotes, one at a time per back-promote branch; rollbacks, one at
# a time per org; the nightly archive, one at a time.
concurrency:
  group: release-relay-${{ github.event_name == 'schedule' && 'archive' || (inputs.mode == 'rollback' && format('rollback-{0}', inputs.target_environment) || (inputs.mode == 'sync' && inputs.target || inputs.branch)) }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  RELAY_PROVIDER: github
  REQUEST_ID: ${{ inputs.request_id }}
  MODE: ${{ inputs.mode }}
  ENVIRONMENT: ${{ inputs.environment }}
  TARGET_ENVIRONMENT: ${{ inputs.target_environment }}
  BRANCH: ${{ inputs.branch }}
  TARGET: ${{ inputs.target }}
  TITLE: ${{ inputs.title }}

jobs:
  raise:
    if: ${{ inputs.mode == 'org' || inputs.mode == 'branch' || inputs.mode == 'promote' || inputs.mode == 'hub' || inputs.mode == 'resolve' }}

    environment: ${{ inputs.environment }}
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:

      - name: Create GitHub App token
        id: app
        if: ${{ vars.RELAY_APP_ID != '' }}
        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@v1
        with:
          app-id: ${{ vars.RELAY_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELAY_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          token: ${{ steps.app.outputs.token || github.token }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
      # The Salesforce CLI (major version 2) is cached per runner OS and month, so most runs skip the install.
      - name: Salesforce CLI cache key
        id: sfkey
        if: ${{ (inputs.mode == 'org' && inputs.components != '') || inputs.mode == 'hub' }}
        run: echo "key=relay-sf-cli2-${RUNNER_OS}-node22-$(date -u +%Y-%m)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Cache Salesforce CLI
        if: ${{ (inputs.mode == 'org' && inputs.components != '') || inputs.mode == 'hub' }}
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.relay-sf
          key: ${{ steps.sfkey.outputs.key }}
      - name: Install Salesforce CLI
        if: ${{ (inputs.mode == 'org' && inputs.components != '') || inputs.mode == 'hub' }}
        run: |
          [ -x "$HOME/.relay-sf/bin/sf" ] || npm install --global --prefix "$HOME/.relay-sf" @salesforce/cli@2 --no-audit --no-fund
          echo "$HOME/.relay-sf/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
      # Inputs reach the script only as environment variables, never inside a shell command.
      - name: Raise pull request
        env:
          STEP: raise
          OPTIONS: ${{ inputs.options }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app.outputs.token || github.token }}
          COMPONENTS: ${{ inputs.components }}
          DELETIONS: ${{ inputs.deletions }}
          ORG_LABEL: ${{ vars.ORG_LABEL }}
          ALLOWED_TARGETS: ${{ vars.ALLOWED_TARGETS }}
          SOURCE_PATH: ${{ vars.SOURCE_PATH }}
          WRITE_DESTRUCTIVE_MANIFEST: ${{ vars.WRITE_DESTRUCTIVE_MANIFEST }}
          SF_INSTANCE_URL: ${{ vars.SF_INSTANCE_URL }}
          SF_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.SF_USERNAME }}
          SF_CLIENT_ID: ${{ secrets.SF_CLIENT_ID }}
          SF_JWT_KEY: ${{ secrets.SF_JWT_KEY }}
          SF_JKS: ${{ secrets.SF_JKS }}
          SF_JKS_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.SF_JKS_PASSWORD }}
          SF_JKS_ALIAS: ${{ vars.SF_JKS_ALIAS }}
        run: node scripts/release-relay.js

  scan:
    needs: raise
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && fromJSON(inputs.options || '{}').scan != 'off' && (needs.raise.result == 'success' || inputs.mode == 'check') }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.branch }}
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'
      # The Salesforce CLI and the Code Analyzer plugin are cached per runner OS and month.
      - name: Salesforce CLI cache key
        id: sfkey
        run: echo "key=relay-sf-scan-cli2-${RUNNER_OS}-node22-$(date -u +%Y-%m)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Cache Salesforce CLI and Code Analyzer
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.relay-sf
            ~/.local/share/sf
          key: ${{ steps.sfkey.outputs.key }}
      - name: Install Salesforce CLI and Code Analyzer
        run: |
          [ -x "$HOME/.relay-sf/bin/sf" ] || npm install --global --prefix "$HOME/.relay-sf" @salesforce/cli@2 --no-audit --no-fund

          echo "$HOME/.relay-sf/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          sf plugins 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'code-analyzer' || sf plugins install code-analyzer
      - name: Code scan
        env:
          STEP: scan
          SOURCE_PATH: ${{ vars.SOURCE_PATH }}
          SCAN_RULES: ${{ vars.SCAN_RULES }}
          SCAN_BLOCK_SEVERITY: ${{ vars.SCAN_BLOCK_SEVERITY }}

        run: |
          git show "$GITHUB_SHA:scripts/release-relay.js" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-relay.js"

  validate:

    if: ${{ !cancelled() && inputs.target_environment != '' && (needs.raise.result == 'success' || inputs.mode == 'check') }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: ${{ inputs.target_environment }}
    timeout-minutes: 120
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.branch }}
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
      # The Salesforce CLI (major version 2) is cached per runner OS and month, so most runs skip the install.
      - name: Salesforce CLI cache key
        id: sfkey
        run: echo "key=relay-sf-cli2-${RUNNER_OS}-node22-$(date -u +%Y-%m)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.relay-sf
          key: ${{ steps.sfkey.outputs.key }}

          echo "$HOME/.relay-sf/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
      - name: Validate against the target org
        env:
          STEP: validate
          OPTIONS: ${{ inputs.options }}
          SOURCE_PATH: ${{ vars.SOURCE_PATH }}
          DEPLOY_TEST_LEVEL: ${{ vars.DEPLOY_TEST_LEVEL }}
          SF_INSTANCE_URL: ${{ vars.SF_INSTANCE_URL }}
          SF_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.SF_USERNAME }}
